checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13; all volumes within pipette ranges (40 µL, 180 µL strokes, 166.7 µL strokes, 80 µL multi; 250 µL with the p1000); reservoir columns stay within 15 mL (reservoir_columns_within_15ml check passed); labware used as intended.

Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed with 48 distinct tips. Each sample uses its own p1000 tip. The multichannel dispenses reagents at well tops with a single tip that never aspirates from a sample well. Fresh tips are used per column for removal, elution and recovery. Every tip is dropped, and the 200 µL tip count (34 columns) fits within the 36 available.

The code follows steps 1–14 in order with the specified volumes and delays (5 min, 4 min, two 500 µL washes, 4 min dry, 30 s, 90 s). The magnet is disengaged and the temperature module set to 4 °C first, and the magnet is disengaged at the end. The only extras are a harmless bead pre-mix and a 10x elution mix (the task says to mix to resuspend).
The 48_samples_to_odd_columns and distinct_elution_wells checks passed; the code pairs sample_tubes with odd-column wells one to one, and the eluate goes to elution wells in the same column and row.

Beads 40 µL, then isopropanol 250 µL, then sample 250 µL with p1000.mix(5,...). Code then runs delay(5 min), engage, delay(4 min), and removes 540 µL with the magnet on. The binding_volumes, mix_5x, incubation and magnet_4min checks all passed.

Two loops each add 500 µL ethanol and remove it to waste with the magnet engaged, then delay(minutes=4) with the magnet still on, then disengage. The two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min checks passed.

The magnet is disengaged, 100 µL elution buffer is added and mixed, then 30 s wait, engage, 90 s wait, then 80 µL recovered to distinct wells of the 4 °C plate. The elution_100ul, elution_off_magnet_then_90s_on and distinct_elution_wells checks passed.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and passes all 17 measured run-log checks, with correct volumes, order, timings, magnet states and tip handling. I found no deviations from the specification other than harmless extra mixing, so all items score 1.
